title: Pass the benchmark reasoning setting to `reviewPlan`.
comment:
**Pass the benchmark reasoning setting to `reviewPlan`.**

The `haiku-none` arm sets `reasoningEffort: "none"` and `maxTokens: 900`, but `reviewPlan` overrides the adapter with request-level `"low"` when the option is omitted. The benchmark’s fetch assertion then rejects the emitted `{ effort: "low" }` payload because it expects `{ effort: "none" }`. The low-reasoning request also violates the documented Anthropic budget for a 900-token limit.

Pass `armConfig().reasoningEffort` in this caller. Do not remove `PLAN_REVIEW_REASONING` globally because the normal production path and focused test expect the default review setting to remain `"low"`.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-    const result = await reviewPlan(model, async (entry) => { spend.push(entry); }, reply.moment, input, { maxTokens: armConfig().maxTokens });
+    const result = await reviewPlan(model, async (entry) => { spend.push(entry); }, reply.moment, input, { maxTokens: armConfig().maxTokens, reasoningEffort: armConfig().reasoningEffort });
```

</details>
